pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: scripts/docs/feature-doc-map.json:602 The only doc-map entry that targets docs/development/change-review.md watches scripts/docs/** alone, so a change to scripts/review/** (new constitution rule, renamed lens, changed exit code) never owes the document that describes these lenses rule by rule; evaluate() returns UNMAPPED for scripts/review/constitution-check.mjs and gate-check.mjs.

techniques.evidence: scripts/docs/feature-doc-map.json:602 change-review.md names constitution-check.mjs, agent-review.mjs, rubric.mjs, source-mask.mjs, gate-check.mjs and workflow-yaml.mjs (lines 12-545), but no sourceGlob covers scripts/review/**. The entry's own _comment at :599 says the doc 'already names ... the review lenses', which records the coupling as lore instead of data.

scripts/review/constitution-check.mjs:700 With no comparable base the run exits 2 and prints 'NOTHING was reviewed'. A narrowed range is announced. The agent lens is advisory by a written decision (agent-review.mjs:25-28) and prints THE JUDGEMENT LENS DID NOT RUN when it skips.

scripts/review/constitution-check.mjs:30 The correction is dated and in place, and it keeps the old behaviour visible: free-prose trailers used to downgrade every non-secret finding. It also states the observed consequence.

scripts/review/workflow-yaml.mjs:19 A dependency-free reader built for jobs that never ran npm ci. A partial read surfaces as a blocking unparsed-workflow finding instead of passing quietly. rubric.mjs's markdown scrape is guarded by agent-review.test.mjs:153 (each section must be longer than 200 chars), not by an 'at least one' floor.

scripts/review/rubric.mjs:64 The judgement lens hands the doc-sync obligation to a reviewer that reads the git range (diffForRange/messagesForRange), not a transcript. It is advisory only; the blocking doc gate lives in scripts/docs.
